Sora2.prompt: Cinematic tracking shot in ancient Chinese anime style. A young Chinese woman in pale green ruqun dress, 18 years old with long flowing black hair, runs desperately toward a door in a dilapidated wooden house at night. Her panicked expression shows fear with contracted pupils, skirt and hair flying in motion. Suddenly, a sharp sword sweeps through the air from the left, creating a cold gleaming arc that blocks her escape path. The sword is wielded by a pale sickly young man, 22 years old, in a worn wooden wheelchair, wearing a dark black traditional robe. He has a cold mocking sneer on his thin pale lips, narrow phoenix eyes with dark intense gaze. The woman stumbles backward in terror, collapses to the ground with tears in her fearful eyes. Dynamic candlelit room with moving shadows and dust particles, cold blue lighting dominates. Fast dolly forward tracking movement that starts constant speed then suddenly stops with handheld shake effect, speed ramp deceleration. Motion blur on the running and sword strike. Desperate escape attempt blocked, power imbalance dramatically established.

SeeDance.prompt: 古风动漫风格，电影感跟拍镜头。辛月影，18岁少女，身穿淡青色交领襦裙，长发及腰，在破旧木屋中惊慌地冲向门口，表情惊恐惧怕，瞳孔收缩，裙摆和发丝飞扬。突然一道寒光闪过，沈清起的长剑划破空气，封死她的退路。沈清起，22岁病弱青年，脸色苍白如纸，坐在破旧木制轮椅上，身穿玄色交领长袍，狭长凤眼阴鸷深邃，嘴角挂着冷笑。辛月影被剑气逼退，跌坐在地，眼中含泪，绝望无助。昏暗的烛火摇曳，光影动态变化，冷青色光线笼罩。快速跟拍，急停转手持晃动，速度骤减。运动模糊效果。逃跑失败，绝望被困。
